name: Shadow Traveler (Fetchling)
body:
You are able to take others with you when you journey to your home plane.

Prerequisite: Fetchling, plane shift spell-like abilty, character level 15th

Benefit: You can use plane shift an additional time each day, and can now take along other willing creatures. You may still only shift to either the Material Plane or the Plane of Shadow.

Normal: Fetchlings may not bring other creatures with them when using their plane shift spell-like ability.
